findings: No blocking findings. The Director clarification requires applied task context, contextual routing, recovery of incomplete relevant reads, and pivot-scoped revalidation without imposing repeated full bootstraps on unchanged routine work.

The visual clarification requires coherent autonomous formative self-inspection and a few risk-relevant checks, while preserving the separate Definition-of-Ready and meaningful stage-exit review boundary rather than creating per-edit formal review.
Direct visual and spatial plausibility controls visible acceptance ahead of counts or numerical detail, while protective preflight and required functional and technical checks remain mandatory.

The two-document delta adds no role, permission, routing default, universal preview gate, duplicated standalone policy, game authority, or claim that future output improvement has already been proved.
